# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m152 and Graphite backends**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. It ports more math to managed C# for a performance boost, fixes several native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs, adds async pixel readback and Vulkan via Silk.NET, and switches all solutions to the .slnx format.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m152** — Bundles Chrome milestone m152 along with follow-up upstream m151/m152 bug-fix merges. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving consumers an early path to Skia's next-generation renderer. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — Adds RequestReadPixels to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous pixel reads that work across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan via Silk.NET and containerized test coverage** — Ships the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux, plus new containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and FreeType-based font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free and leak fixes** — Fixes native use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the owning object, and fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create's raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed math and hot-path optimizations** — Caches a HandleDictionary reflection check, optimizes SKData.SaveTo to skip a double buffer copy, avoids an intermediate string allocation in encoded-text reads, and pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Deterministic binding generation and Windows SDK flexibility** — Makes binding generation deterministic across build platforms, converts all .sln solutions to .slnx, initializes the MSVC environment once per native build, and stops pinning a default Windows SDK version. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612), [#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz binding alongside the .slnx solution conversion and the new containerized test infrastructure.
